description: List the largest token accounts for an asset with each one's share of supply, the wallet that owns it, and whether it is frozen. Concentration is the practical exit-risk measure for a tokenized asset, though the top of this list is usually liquidity pools and custodians rather than end investors.

asset.description: Registry symbol such as TSLAx, or any Solana mint address.

limit.description: How many accounts to list. The RPC returns at most 20.

resolveOwners.description: Resolve the wallet behind each token account. Costs one extra RPC read.

name: get_holder_concentration
title: Read holder concentration
